summary: CMS for education, news and announcements with an independent AUTHOR role (P2-D11). AUTHOR and CONTENT_ADMIN are new account roles and operational contexts reached only by /author and /content, granted and suspended by the superadmin at /admin/roles with a reason; /api/context now refuses every operational context from the shared list, closing a direct-post switch into the new ones. Migration 0018 adds content_item (live fields, status DRAFT/PUBLISHED/HIDDEN/ARCHIVED/DELETED, publish_at, moderation note, version), content_revision snapshots per save, content_category per type and content_slug_redirect. Authors write education and news, content admins also announcements; club posts wait for clubs (PROMPT-010). Authors see only their own content (others' is NOT_FOUND) and cannot act on content the admin hid or deleted; admin moves on others' content and archive/hide/delete/restore require a reason; every save is a revision with a version conflict check and a field-level audit; revisions restore as new revisions. Scheduling is PUBLISHED with a future publish_at decided at read time, with no scheduler. Education needs a source and a review date to publish. Persian or latin slugs unique per type with 308 redirects; duplicate titles need explicit confirmation. Public /articles, /news and /announcements lists with categories and empty states, and detail pages with byline (display name only when the author shows it), dates, image, sources, related breed, Article/NewsArticle JSON-LD, archived notice with noindex, 404 for draft/scheduled/hidden/deleted. Content images are stored privately (CONTENT_IMAGE) and served at /media/[id] only while visible or archived content shows them. Breed pages list related published content; sitemap gains three sections.
